answer: A newcomer posts a 7 POA bond and must prove a real delta: each epoch its useful work must measurably improve on its own previous job, checked live by a stranger re-running both and staking 2 POA. A gale audit randomly re-runs one past job; a copied or flat delta slashes the bond and earns nothing. The nth identity from one wallet must show n separate deltas at once, posting 7n-squared POA — 1st 7, 10th 700, 2,695 across ten. At zenith a public board ranks every delta, so clones replaying one job cannot climb.
